description: Laravel wrapper around OAuth 1 & OAuth 2 libraries.

latest_release.name: v5.32.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix static analysis issues by @nguyentranchung in https://github.com/laravel/socialite/pull/793
* Remove security policy in favor of the org-wide default by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/socialite/pull/796
* Bump shivammathur/setup-php from 2.37.2 to 2.40.0 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/laravel/socialite/pull/797
* Dependency floor bump by @joetannenbaum in https://github.com/laravel/socialite/pull/798
* Resolve relative OAuth callbacks against the configured application URL by @ClaraLeigh in https://github.com/laravel/socialite/pull/799

## New Contributors
* @ClaraLeigh made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/socialite/pull/799

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/laravel/socialite/compare/v5.31.0...v5.32.0

detail.readme: ## Introduction Laravel Socialite provides an expressive, fluent interface to OAuth authentication with Bitbucket, Facebook, GitHub, GitLab, Google, LinkedIn, Slack, Twitch, and X. It handles almost all of the boilerplate social authentication code you are dreading writing. **We are not accepting new adapters.** Adapters for other platforms are listed at the community driven [Socialite Providers](https://socialiteproviders.com/) website. ## Official Documentation Documentation for Socialite can be found on the [Laravel website](https://laravel.com/docs/socialite). ## Contributing Thank you for considering contributing to Socialite! The contribution guide can be found in the [Laravel documentation](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions). ## Code of Conduct In order to ensure that the Laravel community is welcoming to all, please review and abide by the [Code of Conduct](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions#code-of-conduct). ## Security Vulnerabilities Please review [our security policy](https://github.com/laravel/socialite/security/policy) on how to report security vulnerabilities. ## License Laravel Socialite is open-sourced software licensed under the [MIT license](LICENSE.md).
